_comment: The analytics events the apps may send, once (NP-APP-TELEMETRY-001 §3 and §7; REQ-SW03-07). The shared core reads this file at build time (common/npps-core/src/analytics.rs, op checkAnalyticsEvent) and every app asks the core, so iOS and Android cannot disagree about what leaves the phone. It is an ALLOWLIST, of names as well as of properties: an event is sent only if its name is one of `events`, exactly, and every property is named here and carries a value of one of its forms. A name not listed, a property not named, or a value not of its form drops the whole event; there is no list of names or keys to forbid at run time, because one nobody thought of would pass it (OI-PRIV-05). A form is {literal: [..]} (one of these exact texts), {prefixDigits: {prefix, max}} (the prefix then digits, at most max of them) or {dotted: {prefixes, parts, max}} (one of the prefixes and a space, then `parts` numbers joined by dots, each at most max digits; with no prefixes, just the numbers). `forbiddenTerms` is the policy's §7 list; it is not consulted when an event is checked, and a test in analytics.rs fails the build if an event name or a literal value in this file contains one. `error_code` is a literal list and `errorCodeMeanings` says what each code means: a code is added only for a failure of the app itself (network, cloud storage, firmware update, the shared core), never for anything raised during or about a session, a consent, an electrode contact or a helmet fault, because a helmet fault can be a physiological halt (CLAUDE.md §5.1 rule 2). Every code is above 255 so that no one-byte helmet fault slot or module fault code is ever a permitted value. `screen_name` has no session screen and no consent screen: under the installation's stable ID each would be a timestamped record of a session or of a research or clinician relationship. To add an event, a property or a value, change the spec (NP-APP-TELEMETRY-001 §3, Privacy Lead review) and this file together. The digit bounds are not in the spec: docs/status/unjustified-choices.md UC-094.

errorCodeMeanings.1001: a network request failed or timed out
errorCodeMeanings.1101: firmware update: the helmet was not connected
errorCodeMeanings.1102: firmware update: the image could not be loaded
errorCodeMeanings.1103: firmware update: the image's signature was invalid
errorCodeMeanings.1104: firmware update: the image was of the wrong kind
errorCodeMeanings.1106: firmware update: the hub rejected the image (the hub's own code is not carried)
errorCodeMeanings.1201: the shared core could not be loaded or asked
